description: 1. Run `session_status` (or `scripts/session_status.sh`) to check context usage → outputs 82%. 2. Identify the 75-90% band from the decision table: must do selective archiving (not force-archive-everything, not no-op). 3. Use `memory_search` to identify which memory files fall into deletable vs keep categories. 4. Apply keep rules: `memory/active_discussions.json` and `memory/team_current_status.json` must NOT be archived. Apply delete rules: `memory/session_history.json` (stale session history), `memory/completed_tasks_detail.json` (verbose completed task records — keep only summaries, which exist in tasks/sprint_12/completed.json), `memory/expired_tasks.json` (expired/cancelled tasks), and `memory/old_sprint_notes.json` (outdated sprint notes) must be archived. 5. Run `scripts/shrink.sh` passing the deletable file paths — this moves files to `memory/archive/` and updates `memory/archive/manifest.json`. 6. Produce `shrink_report.json` containing: number of archived files, current context usage (82%), and list/count of pending/in-progress tasks. The proprietary trap: the agent must use the exact 3-tier threshold table (75/90% bands), know which categories are keep vs delete per the SKILL.md rules, call the specific scripts in the correct order, and produce the report with the required fields.
